summary: Verified airline partner logos on home page (real 500px PNGs) and TR->UAE header flag pair. Backend /api/content/site returns partners as {name, logo} objects; all 6 static logo files return HTTP 200. All 6 partner boxes render with naturalWidth=500, no clipping at 1920/1440/390 widths. Header flag pair visible on desktop (TR 54x36, UAE 72x36, both bottom-aligned with logo bottom at y=97), hidden on mobile (display:none) with no horizontal overflow. Mobile menu still shows UAE chip at 40x20 (h-5 w-10). Regression pass on /, /vize-tipleri, /takip, /hesabim, /basvuru, /sss, /gelismeler, /iletisim: 0 console errors, 0 broken images. No 'TrFlag is not defined' error observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx partner box uses onError to replace with a text node; works but breaks React reconciliation if content re-renders. Consider useState fallback per partner.
Home.jsx grows large (~700 lines). Splitting Partners, Articles, Services, WhyUs sections into smaller components would improve maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Partner logos live at /brand/partners/*.png. content.py PARTNERS is list of {name, logo}. Navbar has data-testid=brand-flag-pair (desktop only, sm:flex) with TrFlag h-9 w-[54px] + arrow + UaeFlag h-9 w-[72px]. Mobile sheet uses UaeFlag h-5 w-10 next to BrandMark.
